0.title: Understanding feature status
0.text: Understanding feature status - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Understanding feature status Available means a registered adapter is exposed for configuration. Beta means the feature is usable but has narrower guarantees or provider limits. Unavailable means a provider, review, contract, or other prerequisite prevents activation. The page may still describe the planned experience. Status is not a substitute for server health. A module can be available globally and still be misconfigured in one server because of channel permissions, role hierarchy, or a missing intent. Vozen Helper documentation Privacy - Terms

1.title: Install Vozen Helper
1.text: Install Vozen Helper - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Install Vozen Helper Open the official Vozen Helper panel and choose Add to Discord . Select only a server where you have permission to manage the server. Discord will show the requested scopes and permissions before installation. Before you continue Confirm that you control the server or have delegated setup access. Keep the Helper role below the roles it needs to manage. Enable the privileged intents requested by the installation and required by your chosen modules. Never paste bot tokens into the panel, documentation, or a browser address bar. Vozen Helper documentation Privacy - Terms

2.title: Welcome to Vozen Helper
2.text: Welcome to Vozen Helper - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Welcome to Vozen Helper Vozen Helper is a Discord bot and web panel for server owners. This documentation starts with tasks, then opens the technical detail when you need it. How to use these docs Pick a task that matches your goal. Read the requirements before changing anything. Use the panel preview and preflight. Publish, observe health, and keep the revision available for rollback. The documentation is generated from the Helper's public technical manifest. If a detail is not in that manifest, it is not presented as a guaranteed capability. Vozen Helper documentation Privacy - Terms

4.title: Choose a server
4.text: Choose a server - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Choose a server Every Helper configuration is scoped to one Discord server. Changing the selected server changes the data you are viewing; it does not copy settings between servers. If a server is missing, check that your Discord account has a management permission and that the Helper is installed there. Never use a URL containing a guild ID as a public documentation link. 5.title: Publish external alerts
5.text: Publish external alerts - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Publish external alerts Start with one provider and one destination channel. Confirm the source, review quota and delivery health, then send a test. RSS has no credential requirement; YouTube and Twitch require server-side credentials and provider setup. documents.text: Install Vozen Helper - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Install Vozen Helper Open the official Vozen Helper panel and choose Add to Discord . documents.text: Glossary - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Glossary Adapter - the technical contract that validates, previews, publishes, and reports health for one module. Preflight - a permission and dependency check immediately before a change is published. Revision - an immutable published configuration snapshot that can be restored. Unavailable - a dependency or approval prevents activation today; the page is informational only. Vozen Helper documentation Privacy - Terms

documents.title: Privacy and data
documents.text: Privacy and data - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Privacy and data Vozen Helper keeps configuration, audit metadata, and the minimum event data required for enabled modules. Message content is not presented as retained by default. Read each module's retention setting before enabling content snapshots. Use the panel's export and deletion controls when available. Secrets stay server-side and never belong in public URLs or documentation. Vozen Helper documentation Privacy - Terms

documents.title: Missing permissions
documents.text: Missing permissions - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Missing permissions Open the module preflight. Read the exact permission and channel named there. Check role permissions and channel overwrites. Refresh the server context and simulate again. Do not grant Administrator as a shortcut. Grant the smallest permission set that passes the operation. Vozen Helper documentation Privacy - Terms

documents.text: Provider failures - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Provider failures Look at the provider's last success, retry time, quota, and circuit state. documents.title: Role hierarchy
documents.text: Role hierarchy - Vozen Helper Skip to content Vozen Helper Quick Setup Modules Guides Reference Troubleshooting Search documentation Role hierarchy Discord only lets the bot manage roles below its highest role, and only lets a moderator act below their own highest role. Move the Helper role above the target role, then run preflight again. Managed and integration roles cannot be moved by the Helper. Vozen Helper documentation Privacy - Terms
